Fig. 2:MambaAct architecture.MambaAct retains and jointly fine-tunes the pretrainedπ0.5\pi_{0.5}visual-language backbone while replacing its Transformer action expert
with a compact Mamba-3 expert. The VLM prefix is compressed into visual,
language, and learned-query global context tokens𝐂\mathbf{C}and pooled
into𝐳\mathbf{z}, which block-specific FiLM MLPs map to scale, shift, and
residual-gate parameters. The noisy action chunk𝐗t\mathbf{X}_{t}is
projected into the initial action-token sequence𝐇(0)\mathbf{H}^{(0)}, while
the embedded flow time𝐜t\mathbf{c}_{t}is injected through block-specific
projections. TheL=4L=4gated Mamba-3 blocks transform the full action-token
sequence into𝐇(L)\mathbf{H}^{(L)}, and a final RMSNorm-linear head predicts
the flow velocity𝐕^θ\hat{\mathbf{V}}_{\theta}. Repeated Euler updates use this
velocity to obtain the denoised action chunk𝐗0\mathbf{X}_{0}.
